## next

1. M: Decide `same_sample_id_required`/`same_assay_required`: keys are parsed but
   have no behavioral consumer; honor them or reject non-default values.
2. M: Phase 2 candidates in priority order: sourmash sequence-content comparison,
   reference-aware coverage comparison, processing-aware merged-read checks.
3. M: Recalibrate example thresholds with genuine between-run data — the shifan
   replicate band (GC ≤ 0.044, length ≤ 10.8) is the first such evidence.
4. L: Profile pysam BAM iteration; per-record access still dominates the scan.
5. L: Bioconda PR #70765 — comment `@BiocondaBot please add label` once every
   CI check is green, then track review/merge and verify installability from
   the bioconda channel.

## recommendation

1. M: Treat COMPATIBLE results as technical assessments only; genotype-based
   identity verification (Phase 3) remains necessary for biological claims.
2. L: Add PyPI trusted publishing to the release workflow now that the
   repository is public.
3. L: When calibrating, record the calibration dataset provenance (shifan
   Run0001/Run0002, 2026-10-23 transfer) beside any policy deriving thresholds
   from it.
